LBR.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.
CJ Lewis is a private Liblaw product with no government user stated.
No public body is stated to use CJ Lewis inside a sector's system.

facts.fact: Liblaw, Liberia's largest digital law library, launched on 31 July 2026 the AI legal assistant CJ Lewis, which it calls the country's first legal-learning AI, built on its platform of Supreme Court opinions from 1861 to 2026, statutes and regulations.
